corrections.text: The article contrasts The Register (published 04:06 PT on 2026-11-12) with Microsoft's Windows 11, version 26H2 page, which shows 'Last updated: 2026-11-12, 10:50 PT', 6 hours 44 minutes after the Register article, while the other Microsoft pages show 2026-11-11, 15:37 PT. Microsoft's pages do not say what changed at 10:50 PT, so the Register's statement may describe the pages as they stood earlier; the two sources are not necessarily in conflict at the same moment.

The article says the Herald did not open the pages for Windows 11 23H2, Windows Server 2016 and Windows Server 2012 R2. Those pages exist (status-windows-11-23h2, status-windows-10-1607-and-windows-server-2016, status-windows-8.1-and-windows-server-2012-r2); each lists the issue as Confirmed with the originating update dated 2026-10-13 (KB5126653, KB5126868 and KB5126836 respectively), was last updated 2026-11-11, 15:37 PT, and lists the same 12 affected platforms without Windows 11 26H2.
